1.w: A song of ascents; by David. Look! How good and how pleasant it is when brothers truly live in unity.

2.w: It is like fine oil poured on the head, which flows down the beard — Aaron’s beard, and then flows down his garments.

3.w: It is like the dew of Hermon, which flows down upon the hills of Zion. Indeed, that is where the Lord has decreed a blessing will be available—eternal life.
